description_en: Deletes a destination route entry from an IPsec-VPN connection
description_zh: 调用DeleteVcoRouteEntry接口删除IPsec连接下的目的路由条目
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-vco-route-entry --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-connection-id vco-p0w5112fgnl2ihlmf0000 --route-dest 192.168.10.0/24 --weight 100 --next-hop vco-p0w5112fgnl2ihlmf0000 --overlay-mode Ipsec --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-42660000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteVcoRouteEntry

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection
parameters.name: vpn_connection_id

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the destination route entry to delete
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的目的路由条目的目标网段
parameters.name: route_dest

parameters.help_en:
The weight of the destination route entry to delete. Valid values:

- **0**: low priority.
- **100**: high priority
parameters.help_zh:
待删除的目的路由条目的权重值。取值：

- **0**：表示低优先级。
- **100**：表示高优先级
parameters.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The next hop of the destination route entry to delete
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的目的路由条目的下一跳
parameters.name: next_hop

parameters.help_en: The tunneling protocol. Set the value to **Ipsec** (default), which specifies the IPsec tunneling protocol
parameters.help_zh: 隧道协议。仅取值：**Ipsec**（默认值），表示IPsec隧道协议
parameters.name: overlay_mode

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** value as the **ClientToken** value. The **RequestId** value is different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样
parameters.name: client_token
